resources.string: Not connected. Enter the hub IP and tap Connect.
Connection interrupted. Check Wi‑Fi and that the hub is running. Retrying…
Connected. Enable IMU, Camera, or ARCore when ready.
ARCore: Not tracking. Point at the room and move gently.
ARCore: Tracking paused. Move to a well-lit area with visible texture.
ARCore: Tracking OK. Stand at the hub depth camera, face the same direction, then tap Align.
Aligned: pose is in the hub map frame. Tap Clear alignment if content drifts.

This app sends data to your hub only on the local network (no encryption in this prototype).

• Hub: stores an RTAB-Map spatial database and session logs on disk.
• Phone: ARCore runs on-device; camera/IMU go to the hub only when you enable those switches.
• Anyone on the same Wi‑Fi could reach an unprotected hub — use a trusted network.

See the repo file docs/privacy-poc.md for full detail.
